title: Music has scales / raagas. What about storytelling in movies and prestige shows?
summary: A philosophical inquiry exploring whether storytelling in films and prestige TV shows could follow structured narrative frameworks analogous to musical scales or raagas, suggesting the existence of underlying storytelling patterns that could be systematically analyzed and applied.
problem_solved: Explores whether storytelling can be systematized through discoverable patterns or frameworks, similar to how music uses scales to structure compositions.
why_valuable: Raises an intriguing conceptual question about narrative grammar that could help writers and creators understand and apply underlying story structures more deliberately.
